::: {.print-only .contact-block} felipe.ruiz\@ug.uchile.cl ::: **Project and Funding Director** -- Half-time
*[Nodo XXI Foundation](https://www.nodoxxi.cl/)* [*2019 --- present*]{.cvdate} - An NGO whose aim is the social and political democratisation of Chilean society, with a view to building a fairer, freer and more egalitarian society. - I am a member of the Executive Board of Nodo XXI and am responsible for the portfolio of international funding projects for research and advocacy, totalling approximately USD 50,000 per year. **Chief Executive Officer** -- Half-time
*[Estrategia Sur](https://estrategiasur.cl/)* [*2024 --- present*]{.cvdate} - Consulting firm specialised in data science for strategic decision-making. - Founding partner and as CEI I am responsible for general administrative and commercial management. ## Education ### Professional **[Summer Institute in Computational Social Sciences.](https://sicss.io/2026/buenos-aires/)** -- Profesional Specialization
*Institute of Advanced Social Studies, National University of San Martín* [*2026*]{.cvdate} **[AI Specialization](https://anthropic.skilljar.com/)** -- Profesional Specialization
*Anthropic Academy* [*2026*]{.cvdate} **Analysis and synthesis of scientific literature using generative artificial intelligence** -- Profesional Specialization
*Bernardo O'Higgins University* [*2026*]{.cvdate} **Mastering ChatGPT for Writing and Awarding Research Projects** -- Profesional Specialization
*Diego Portales University* [*2025*]{.cvdate} **[Data Science](https://www.coursera.org/account/accomplishments/specialization/L53LGQM762N2)** -- Profesional Specialization
*John Hopkins University* [*2024*]{.cvdate} **[Programming & Data Science Instructor](https://carpentries.org/instructors/)** -- Profesional Specialization
*The Carpentries* [*2023*]{.cvdate} **[Program of Advanced Studies on Latin American Economies](https://elades.cepal.org/en)** -- Profesional Specialization
*UN Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean* [*2023*]{.cvdate} **[Summer School in Computational Social Sciences, Methods for Analysing Multimedia Data](https://www.gesis.org/en/research/projects-and-exchange/conferences/events-archive/css-events)** -- Profesional Specialization
*GESIS Leibniz Institute for The Social Sciences* [*2019*]{.cvdate} ### Academic **PhD -- Social Sciences**
*University of Chile* [*2026*]{.cvdate} - Thesis title: [*The capitalist class in Chile today (2000–2019). A study of the Luksic and Cencosud business groups*](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/371500552_La_Clase_Capitalista_en_el_Chile_contemporaneo_1990-2020_un_estudio_basado_en_el_caso_de_los_grupos_economicos_Luksic_y_Cencosud_The_Capitalist_Class_in_Contemporary_Chile_1990-2020_A_study_based_on_t) - National Research and Development Agency. *Excellence PhD Scholarship* (2021-2025). **MSc -- Social Sciences**
*University of Chile* [*2019*]{.cvdate} - Thesis title: [*The entrepreneurship of the pension system in Chile (2000-2018)*](https://repositorio.uchile.cl/handle/2250/178848) - National Research and Development Agency. *Excellence MSc Scholarship* (2017-2019) **BSc -- Sociology**
*University of Chile* [*2016*]{.cvdate} ## Professional Experience ### Data Scientist **Freelance**
*Multiple clients*[*2017 -- Present*]{.cvdate} Providing data collection, pre-processing, statistical analysis and data visualization services to different clients of the private, scientific and academic sector. The last projects I was involved were: - 2026-2026. *Exchange rates and prospects for industrial development in Uruguay (2000 to the present)*. Cuesta Duarte, PIT-CNT Institute for Research and Training. *Project funded by INEFOP*. [Digital report](https://feliperuizbruzzone.github.io/economia-uruguay/) & [Reproducible repository](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22431771). - 2026-2025. *Computational systematisation of tax statistics by economic sector (2023-1998), based on annual reports from Argentina's Federal Public Revenue Administration*. Instituto de Ciencias, Universidad Nacional de General Sarmiento. *PICT-2020-SERIE-A-00496*. [Reproducible repository](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22431875) - 2024-2023. *Validation of administrative records and statistical analysis: occupational structure of Chile’s Central Government*. Law Faculty, Alberto Hurtado University. *National Fund for Scientific and Technological Development* (grant 1231868). [Digital report](https://rpubs.com/felipesruizb/gobierno-central). - 2021-2022. *Validation and preparation of databases in reproducible format*. Faculty of Social Sciences, Diego Portales University. *National Fund for Scientific and Technological Development* (grant 1171072). ### Academic & Professional Teaching ***Lecturer & Teaching assistant***
*Different institutions*[*2016 -- Present*]{.cvdate} Teaching experience in *social theory*, *social stratification*, *public policies*, *research methods*, *statistical analysis*, *data science*, *computational methods* and *applied artificial intelligence* in different educational contexts: universities (grade and posgraduate courses), professional specializations and particular lessons. I have taught courses on: - Latin American and Chilean *Social Theory*. - *Social stratification and social classes* in Latin America. - Analysis of *Public Policy* in the social and economic spheres, - Foundations of the *R* programming language. - Research methods in the field of social sciences, economics and humanities. - Introduction to *data driven* research projects. - Basic and advanced *statistical methods* in Social Sciences. - *Open Science* and *Free Software* Tools for Quantitative Social Research. - An Introduction to *Computational Social Sciences*. - *Artificial Intelligence* applied to socio-economic research. ## Work in progress - 2027-[The chilean New Left in Government: Limits, Challenges and Lessons](). Santiago de Chile: Fondo de Cultura Económica. Co-author. Peer-reviewed book. - 2027-[Work and pensions: progress and challenges](). In [The chilean New Left in Government: Limits, Challenges and Lessons.](). Santiago de Chile: Fondo de Cultura Económica. Peer-reviewed book. - 2027-[Leading productive development: two contrasting experiences](). In [The chilean New Left in Government: Limits, Challenges and Lessons.](). Santiago de Chile: Fondo de Cultura Económica. Peer-reviewed book. - 2026-[Transformations in the reproduction of the population of Petorca (Chile) and the dispute over water during the expansion of the agricultural frontier (1990–2022)](https://doi.org/10.31235/osf.io/m7hfq_v1). Draft accepted in [Waterlat-Gobacit Network Working Papers](https://waterlat.org/working-papers-series/). Co-authored with: Javiera Rojas Cifuentes. - 2026-[Descriptive Statistics for Research in Communication and Social Sciences. A Brief Introduction](). In [Research Methodology in Communication and Public Opinion.](). Santiago de Chile: Ediciones Universidad Diego Portales. Peer-reviewed book. - 2026-[International expansion and wealth capture in Chilean economic groups during the 21st century](). Draft in progress for [Socioeconomic Review](https://academic.oup.com/ser). ## Recent publications - 2025-[Capitalist class structure in Chile (21st century): a descriptive and multivariate quantitative characterization](https://doi.org/10.1080/07360932.2025.2594524). *Forum for Social Economics*, Special Issue on the Social Consequences of Development in Latin America in the 21st Century. - 2025-[Computational methodology for the analysis of financial information in XBRL format. An initial effort applied to economic groups in Chile](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/398951801_Analisis_computacional_de_informacion_financiera_en_formato_XBRL_Una_aplicacion_a_grupos_economicos_de_Chile_2000-2019). En [Quantitative research: recent methodological strategies for doctoral theses in Economic and Social Sciences](http://hdl.handle.net/11086/559603). Argentina: Publisher of the Faculty of Economic Sciences of the National University of Córdoba. Peer-reviewed book. - 2024-[Solidarity in the contributory pension pillar. A progressive approach to discussing pensions reform](https://library.fes.de/pdf-files/bueros/chile/21701.pdf). Public Policy Report. Friedrich Ebert Stiftüng & Fundación Nodo XXI. Co-author. - 2024-[What to do about student loans and debts? Condone and restructuring to restore the promise of higher education](https://www.nodoxxi.cl/portada/2024/nodo-xxi-realiza-un-estudio-sobre-la-eficiencia-del-sistema-de-creditos-en-chile-y-el-impacto-del-proyecto-sobre-fin-al-cae-y-condonacion-de-deudas-estudiantiles/). Public Policy Report. Santiago de Chile: Fundación Nodo XXI. Coauthor. - 2024-[Financiarización y poder empresarial en el sistema de pensiones chileno](). In [Formas y mecanismos de la dominación financiera en América Latina](https://www.iis.unam.mx/formas-y-mecanismos-de-la-dominacion-financiera-en-america-latina/). México: Instituto de Investigaciones Sociales de la Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México. Author. Peer-reviewed book. - 2024-[What interruptions to the (intellectual and political) project of Popular Unity are still relevant to the present?](). In [La Unidad Popular Interrumpida](https://facso.uchile.cl/publicaciones/221189/la-unidad-popular-interrumpida). Santiago: University of Chile, Social Sciences Faculty Editions. - 2023-[The job of public transport, ride-hailing, and delivery drivers: Conditions during the COVID-19 pandemic and implications for a post-pandemic future](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.tbs.2022.11.004). *Travel, Behaviour, and Society*, vol. 31, pages 63-77. Coauthor. - 2021-[Financialization and the construction of peripheral business power in the Chilean pension system](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-030-71315-7). In *Dependent Capitalisms in Contemporary Latin America and Europe*. Palgrave Macmillan. Author. Peer-reviewed book. - 2019-[Descriptive Statistical Methods for Social Sciences Using Rstudio](https://bookdown.org/gboccardo/manual-ED-UCH/). 2nd Edition. Department of Sociology, University of Chile. *Interactive online manual*. Co-author.
